notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content: Additional animations, sound effects, balance tweeks and difficulty changes, bug fixes, performance optimization, controls tuning and bigger cursor. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: New Update! Alternative control modes to choose from.
notes.content:
- Alternative controls. There is original, casual and WASD control modes in Settings->Controls menu.
- Camera rotation.
- Sniper rifle zoom out.
- Credits in main menu.
- Corrupted/edited savegames would not break main menu.

notes.title: Difficulty has been decreased.
notes.content:
- Valkyrie & Recon got more health.
- Valkyrie & Spectre got ability to knockout enemies with kicks.
- Recon & Spectre got aditional skill point.
- Items and containers now highlighted with blue circles on the map for every character on easy and medium difficulties.
- Map shows rats and roaches only on hard difficulty.
- Minor bug fixes.
